provenance_note: Every figure here was recomputed independently from the 40 raw records in judge_transcripts.jsonl and matched exactly: base 0/20 passes and 9/20 leaks, tuned 5/20 passes and 0 leaks, zero empty responses and zero errors on both, all 40 judged with reasoning, behavior spec dc14f40b in every record, zero_shot strategy for both models. The canonical machine-written artifacts are committed alongside this file.

failure_modes.note: Codes are multi-label; one response can carry several, so counts may exceed the number of scenarios.

training_validation_curve.note: Epoch 1 was the best model. save_total_limit: 1 with no load_best_model_at_end kept the last checkpoint and pruned the best, so the adapter evaluated here is the degraded epoch-3 model.

statistical_note: No bootstrap is implemented in this harness. At N=20 only the leak-rate delta (9/20 -> 0/20) is large enough to be robust; smaller deltas are directional.

conclusions.capability_ceiling_note: The evaluated checkpoint is known-degraded, so this result is a lower bound on what N=600 can do.

recommendation.next_action: Re-train N=600 with load_best_model_at_end: true and metric_for_best_model: eval_loss, same data and hyperparameters and seed, then re-evaluate. One 35-minute run separates 'V1 cannot teach diagnostic accuracy' from 'the wrong epoch was saved'.
